meta.name: postgresql-table-design
meta.description: Use this skill when designing or reviewing a PostgreSQL-specific schema. Covers best-practices, data types, indexing, constraints, performance patterns, and advanced features

copy.tagline: 设计出规范高效的Postgres表结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在为应用设计或审查Postgres表结构,并希望用上实践验证过的方案
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing or reviewing PostgreSQL table schemas and want practical guidance.

howto.what: 设计或审查 PostgreSQL 表结构时,Claude 会按这套规则给出主键、数据类型、索引、约束与分区的具体建议,并产出可直接运行的建表 DDL 示例。
howto.when: 当你设计新的 PostgreSQL 表结构、在上线前审查现有表结构,或为表挑选列类型、建索引等时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一张用户表的 PostgreSQL 建表语句
say.note: 会给出主键、类型和索引的 DDL

say.text: 看看我这个订单表的建表语句有什么问题
say.note: 会指出索引、约束等可改之处

say.text: 订单表数据量很大,该怎么分区?
say.note: 会说明分区方式与限制

howto.what_en: When you design or review a PostgreSQL schema, Claude applies this skill's rules on keys, data types, indexes, constraints and partitioning, and returns ready-to-run DDL examples.
howto.when_en: Use it when you design a new PostgreSQL schema, review one before launch, or need help picking column types or indexes.

say_en.text: Design a PostgreSQL schema for a users table.
say_en.note: Returns DDL with keys, types and indexes.

say_en.text: Review my orders table DDL for problems.
say_en.note: Points out index and constraint fixes.

say_en.text: How should I partition a very large orders table?
